latency_targets: Median end-to-end search (ANN + rerank) p50 ~150ms; p95 <350ms. Lawyer-facing interactive queries must feel instant (sub-200ms p50).

audit_logging_expectations: Token-level request/response traces for rerank decisions where allowed, full access logs, retention 3 years, SIEM integration (Splunk syslog), HMAC-signed log export for compliance audits.
